name: STIX Two Math
evidence: Unmodified STIX Two Math v2.13b171 font is compiled into oriha-latex for SVG rendering. Upstream, exact SHA-256, attribution and the complete OFL are retained in crates/latex/assets/fonts.

name: WHATWG character-reference vocabulary
evidence: The compiled Rust table contains semicolon-terminated names derived from the pinned WHATWG entities input. The original data, source hash and attribution are retained in crates/core/entity-data; the raw JSON is a generation input rather than a runtime resource.

name: GitHub gemoji aliases
evidence: The compiled merged shortcode table contains aliases from the pinned GitHub gemoji commit. It shares a generated Rust file with Unicode-derived data; original inputs and separate upstream rights remain in crates/core/emoji-data.

name: Unicode CLDR English emoji names
evidence: The compiled merged shortcode table also contains names derived from CLDR 48.2.0 English annotations, filtered through Unicode Emoji 16.0. The raw CLDR and emoji-test inputs are retained for regeneration and are not read at runtime.

name: Unicode Emoji allowlist
evidence: Unicode Emoji 16.0 determines which CLDR entries enter the compiled merged shortcode table. Shared-file attribution overlaps intentionally; pinned source data and its license are retained in crates/core/emoji-data.
